user.title: OGN ground station
user.description: Reads voltage, current and power of a breezedudeGS station from the Open Glider Network APRS stream. The station must send data to the APRS server (Send data to APRS server enabled).

data.callsign: Station name (as set in the station)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the APRS server.
error.invalid_callsign: The station name may only contain letters, digits, "-" and "_" (max. 20 characters).

data.timeout: Mark values unavailable after (minutes without status)
